sections.title: Citizens, officers, researchers — we want to hear from you.
sections.subtitle: Pick the channel that matches who you are. Click to open your email client — or copy the address if you'd rather write later.

sections.title: Honest expectations on response time.
body: We are a small platform run with practitioner support. Citizen queries usually get a response within 2–3 working days. Officer / researcher requests, depending on complexity, may take 5–10 days.
If your question is urgent or sensitive, mark it clearly in the subject — we'll route it to the most relevant collaborator.

sections.title: Three doors. One team.
sections.subtitle: Click "Open in email" to start a message in your mail app, or "Copy email" to paste the address wherever you like.

audiences.description: Have a question, a story, or a piece of feedback? Write to us in your own words — we read every message.

sections.title: A note on privacy
sections.body: We do not share your contact details with third parties. Officer and researcher requests are routed to relevant collaborators — with your permission. Citizen messages are handled by a small editorial team.

sections.title: Let's build the next decade of citizen-centric governance — together.
sections.subtitle: States, institutions, civil society, CSR partners and innovators — we welcome long-form conversations on collaboration.
